citation_spot_check: 21 citations read against the full 10-K paragraph on 2026-10-21; all support their sentence. Confirmed: max leverage covenant 5.00x through 2028 [DEBT ¶58], subsidiary guarantees on the 6.75% notes [DEBT ¶63], no single commercial payor above 10% [1 ¶76].
recommendation_vs_grade: Approve with conditions vs internal grade 7 (BB+/BB equivalent; S&P BB, Moody's Ba2). Consistent: sub-investment-grade but serviceable. The conditions target what the grade and stress flag: a leverage covenant set between base ({{FY2025.debt_ebitda}}) and stressed ({{stress.debt_ebitda}}) leverage, no buybacks from proceeds, matching subsidiary guarantees, and hedging past 2028.
known_weakness: Rule 2 (every sentence needs a placeholder or citation) pushes Claude to attach citations to pure judgment sentences, e.g. 'The conditions below address each of these points [DEBT ¶58, ¶63, ¶95]'. The citations are relevant but decorative.
